plainTranslation: A's mind meets B's identity. The conjunction fuses them - intense and inseparable.

summaryDeep: Their questions, explanations, and way of talking sit right on top of your sense of self, confidence, and direction. This is one of the closest contacts between you, strong and constant, energizing at its best and a lot to hold at its worst. Let the closeness feed you without letting it run you.
tension: Remember that feeling understood is not the same as someone knowing everything about you. This person may think they know what you mean before you have finished explaining.
advice: Keep sharing who you are as you grow and change. The real gift here is staying open, curious, and willing to keep learning about each other.
